matrix_title: ClinResearch AI - Statistical Test Selection Matrix

matrix.parametric_conditions: Normality (Shapiro-Wilk p > 0.05) & Homogeneity of Variance (Levene's p > 0.05)
matrix.scientific_justification: Used to compare the means of two independent groups when the data follows a normal distribution and has equal variances.

matrix.relationship: Paired / Repeated Measures (e.g. Pre-op vs Post-op)
matrix.scientific_justification: Used to compare means from the same subjects at two different time points or under matched conditions.

matrix.relationship: Independent (e.g. Group A vs B vs C)
matrix.parametric_conditions: Normality of residuals & Homogeneity of variance
matrix.scientific_justification: Compares means of three or more independent groups. If significant, post-hoc tests (e.g. Tukey's HSD) are applied to locate differences.

matrix.relationship: Paired / Repeated Measures (e.g. T0 vs T1 vs T2)
matrix.parametric_conditions: Sphericity assumption (Mauchly's test p > 0.05) & Normality of residuals
matrix.scientific_justification: Compares the means of three or more matched/repeated measurements on the same subjects over time.

matrix.parametric_conditions: Expected frequency in each cell of the contingency table is at least 5.
matrix.non_parametric_fallback: Fisher's Exact Test (mandatory if any expected cell frequency is < 5)
matrix.scientific_justification: Evaluates the association or independence between two categorical variables.
Compares the survival distributions of two or more independent groups, accounting for right-censored data.
